name: codex-cli-chrome-control
description: Control and verify an existing Chrome session from Codex through a pinned Chrome DevTools MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Use a pinned local Chrome DevTools MCP server to select, inspect, operate, and verify pages in an existing user-approved Chrome session.
capabilities: Recover from unavailable native browser access
defaultPrompt: Use Chrome DevTools Control to inspect and verify the requested page in my existing Chrome session.
